caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle positioned diagonally, filled with a doll lying on its back. The cradle is colored in shades of brown with woodgrain patterns and stands on two curved rockers. The doll has a light beige face with simple painted facial features, black hair, and wears round earrings and a red-orange top. The doll is covered by a yellow quilt or blanket with blue and grayish vertical and horizontal stripes, tucked up to its shoulders. A light pink pillow supports the head of the doll, matching the pinkish-white inner lining of the cradle. The overall composition is centered within a double-lined rectangular border, with the cradle angled from the lower left to the upper right of the image. The artist’s signature, “Anna Alois,” is visible near the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Cradle
